claims: The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day mission around the Moon.
Artemis II Commander is Reid Wiseman of NASA.
Artemis II Pilot is Victor Glover of NASA.
Artemis II Mission Specialist is Christina Hammock Koch of NASA.
Artemis II Mission Specialist is Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency.
Artemis II will be the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972.
Reid Wiseman previously served as Chief of the Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover served as pilot for the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Christina Hammock Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen marks the first Canadian to travel to the Moon.
Artemis II is designed to test the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems for future lunar missions.
